headline: The Blue Castle finally lands
lede: Adventure's duplicate chalice shipped for real tonight: the previous session built the room, wrote the tests and opened the PR — then died before the merge completed. This lane read the board, found the unlanded ship, and captained it into main.

notes.text: ADVENTURE now has 19 rooms: the open Blue Castle off Blue Lab 2 holds a second chalice, and either cup delivered to the Gold Castle wins. The shuffle never re-homes it and never deals the keep out.
A STATE.md that says SHIPPED is a claim; gh pr view state is the fact. The corpse-resume path (step 1b) caught a finished game that its own shift report had already declared merged.
The missing polish pass was filed for real (#3489): variant selector, roaming dragons, gate-rite teaching and the parseGaps ###Restored inflation that makes idle-kick re-kick closed titles.

look.text: Find the second grail in the Blue Castle
